title: Quarterly Scorecard Targets for Insurer Program Agreements
content:
Each tier of the Insurer Program Agreements sets four quarterly performance targets for the network. Two are ceilings the network must not exceed and two are floors it must reach.

| Agreement tier | Average key-to-key cycle time, must not exceed (days) | Customer satisfaction score, must reach | Reinspection pass share, must reach | Supplement frequency, must not exceed |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Network Referral Agreement | 0.0 | 0% | 0% | 0% |
| Select Direct Repair Agreement | 10.5 | 90% | 90% | 45% |
| Preferred Direct Repair Agreement | 9.5 | 92% | 92% | 40% |
| Premier Direct Repair Agreement | 8.5 | 94% | 94% | 35% |
| Managed Repair Program Agreement | 8.0 | 95% | 95% | 35% |
| Enterprise Master Services Agreement | 7.5 | 95% | 96% | 30% |

## The four targets

- **Cycle time** — the quarterly average key-to-key days the network must not exceed (days, to one decimal; 0.0 means no target).
- **Customer satisfaction** — the quarterly customer satisfaction score the network must reach (percent; 0 means no target).
- **Reinspection pass** — the quarterly share of reinspected files passing the insurer audit the network must reach (percent; 0 means no target).
- **Supplement frequency** — the quarterly share of repair orders with a supplement the network must not exceed (percent; 0 means no target).

The Network Referral Agreement row is zero throughout: that tier sets no target on any of the four.

## Direction of each target

| Target | Met when the quarter's figure is | Example on the Premier Direct Repair Agreement (hypothetical quarter) |
|---|---|---|
| Cycle time | equal to or below the target | 8.5 days meets 8.5; 8.6 days exceeds it |
| Customer satisfaction | equal to or above the target | 94% reaches 94%; 93% does not |
| Reinspection pass | equal to or above the target | 94% reaches 94%; 93% does not |
| Supplement frequency | equal to or below the target | 35% does not exceed 35%; 36% exceeds it |

The quarterly figures in the example column are invented; the targets are those of the table above.
